headline: Approved 23 budget and grant items for Community Improvement Program and expedited reports to full Board
summary: The committee approved multiple amending resolutions and budget authorizations for funds ranging from $1,100 to $850,000, covering opioid settlement funds, ARPA programs, fire and police equipment, dental programs, and grant applications. It also voted to expedite its reports on these items to the full Board.
decisions: Approved $106,395.33 for CIP 211723 Opioid Litigation Settlement Trust.
Approved amending resolutions totaling $120,000, $50,000, $45,000, and $66,500 for various FY2022, FY2023, FY2025, and FY2027 Community Improvement Program items.
Approved $110,592.72 for CIP C160060227 Aged and Infirmed Shelter Project.
Approved $68,900 for CIP 611423 ARPA - Homelessness Response & Emergency Shelter Operations.
Approved $1,100 for CIP 712622 ARPA - Revenue Replacement - Roads & Sidewalks.
Approved $25,000 for the City's Special Event Reserve Account.
Approved $72,621.43 for CIP C650050326 Wolfe Park Recreation Complex.
Approved $27,690 for CIP 711324 Municipal Deferred Maintenance.
Approved $77,943 for CIP C200060327 Dilapidated Building Demolition.
Approved $850,000 for CIP C210070227 JFK Coliseum Chiller Plant.
Approved $200,000 for CIP C210070926 FY26 Deferred Maintenance - Municipal.
Approved $25,000 for CIP C300040527 FY25 Hazmat Equipment/Training.
Approved $13,000 for CIP C300040726 Seabrook Station.
Approved $206,998 for CIP C330040327 2025 JAG for City of Manchester, Nashua and Hillsborough County.
Approved $100,000 for CIP C410020127 School Based Dental Program - Medicaid.
Approved $45,000 for CIP C410020227 Oral Health Program.
Approved the ARPA funds expenditure report through June 30, 2026.
Approved extending the CIP C300040327 FY25 Hazmat Grant deadline to August 31, 2028.
Approved transferring funds within CIP 411025 ARPA - MPD Bonuses/Hiring (10 Officers).
Approved authorization to apply for the BJA FY2025/2026 Project Safe Neighborhoods Formula Grant Program.
Approved authorization to apply for Category 1 of the FY 2026 COPS SAFER Outcomes program.
Approved authorization to apply for Category 1 of the FY 2026 Grants to Improve the Criminal Justice Response to Domestic Violence, Dating Violence, Sexual Assault, and Stalking Program.
Approved authorizing department heads to apply directly for grants without City-match requirements without prior Board approval.

COMMITTEE ON COMMUNITY IMPROVEMENT 
September 1, 2026 at 5:45 PM 
 
Chairman Burkush called the meeting to order.   
 
The Clerk called the roll. 
 
Present: Aldermen Burkush, Vincent, Barry, Goonan, Terrio 
 
Messrs.: Mayor Ruais 
 
 
Chairman Burkush: I would like to begin with item 3, please. 
 
3. Amending Resolution and Budget Authorization providing for the acceptance and 
expenditure of funds in the amount of $106,395.33 for CIP 211723 Opioid Litigation 
Settlement Trust. 
 
On motion of Alderman Goonan, duly seconded by Alderman Barry, it was voted to 
approve.   
 
1. Communication from Mayor Ruais requesting approval of the following Amending 
Resolutions and Budget Authorizations: 
• “Amending the FY2022, FY2023, FY2025 and FY2027 Community 
Improvement Program,authorizing, appropriating and transferring funds in the 
amount of One Hundred Twenty Thousand Dollars ($120,000) for the FY2022 
CIP 212322 ARPA - Community Health Worker Program, FY2025 CIP 611125 
Hope for New Hampshire Recovery: Hope Connections andFY2027 CIP 
C160060227 Aged and Infirmed Shelter Project” 
• “Amending the FY2023 and FY2027 Community Improvement Program, 
authorizing, appropriating and transferring funds in the amount of Fifty 
Thousand Dollars ($50,000) for theFY2027 CIP C160060327 1269 Café 
Operations.” 
• “Amending the FY2023 and FY2027 Community Improvement Program, 
authorizing, appropriating and transferring funds in the amount of Forty-Five 
Thousand Dollars ($45,000) for theFY2027 CIP C300040627 Manchester Fire 
Department Squad 1.” 
• “Amending the FY2023 and FY2027 Community Improvement Program, 
authorizing, appropriating and transferring funds in the amount of Sixty-Six 
Thousand Five Hundred Dollars($66,500) for the FY2027 CIP C330040427 
Community Response Unit (CRU).” 
 
Mayor Ruais: I had a wonderful conversation earlier with Director Thomas, and I'll make 
this announcement at the full board as well. As we all know, and as you all know, having 
been former fire chiefs here, the City of Manchester has been tracking overdoses and 
overdose fatalities since 2015. For the month of August, it's the first month that the city 
has ever had, where there was not one recorded overdose fatality in the City of 
Manchester. So, obviously we all know the nature of the opioid epidemic can change

and can be highly variable. But I think this is evidence that the efforts that we've 
undertaken here as a city are working. They're showing progress, they're bearing fruit. 
And so I appreciate consideration of this abatement package and continuing the good 
work I think that's being done here on the board and, of course, throughout the city and 
our community workers who are doing the work on the ground. 
 
Chairman Burkush: Kudos to all the workers. 
 
On motion of Alderman Vincent, duly seconded by Alderman Goonan, it was voted to 
approve. 
 
 
2. Amending Resolution and Budget Authorization providing for the acceptance and 
expenditure of funds in the amount of $110,592.72 for CIP C160060227 Aged 
and Infirmed Shelter Project. 
   
 On motion of Alderman Barry, duly seconded by Alderman Terrio, it was voted to 
approve.

On motion of Alderman Barry, duly seconded by Alderman Vincent, it was voted to 
approve. 
 
On motion of Alderman Barry, duly seconded by Alderman Vincent, it was voted to 
expedite the committee’s reports for agenda items 1 through 6 to the full Board.
